mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperkalemia and nephrotoxicity; tobramycin's aminoglycoside-induced renal impairment reduces eplerenone clearance and increases potassium levels, while eplerenone's potassium-sparing mechanism is potentiated.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; dose adjustment of eplerenone may be necessary if renal function declines.
